changes.description: `PreCompact` and `PostCompact` hooks that run before and after a conversation is compacted
`KIRO_DEFAULT_SETTINGS` names a root-owned file of default settings that your own `cli.json` overrides
`/usage` and an optional `Session credits` status line segment show the session credits so far
Workflow step rows show the credits each step used
Session recap above the prompt after a few idle seconds; opt in through `/settings` under Features or with `chat.enableSessionRecap`
Sub-agents can read the memories of the agent that dispatched them
A prompt is refused with a sign-in message, and not saved, when Kiro cannot get a sign-in token
Agent `file://` resources are capped at 32 files and 100,000 characters; large files are cut or skipped
Notifications queue into one row, most urgent first, with a `+N waiting` count
Warnings and errors stay on screen until you dismiss them with a keypress
Startup cloud config, learnings and steering fetches no longer print tool cards; cloud config instead shows a short notice when it loads or fails
`web_fetch` asks sites for markdown, so docs pages keep their code blocks and links
MCP tool results that return `structuredContent` alongside text or images now include that data as an extra JSON block, unless the server already mirrors it in a text block
Global skills now load in every session when `kiro-cli acp` is started from the home directory
`/agent swap kiro_default` now switches to the default agent
A line of a reply occasionally missing or repeated in the chat transcript
A message sent while a sub-agent runs leaves the queued tray once the sub-agent reads it
A prompt keeps retrying an unanswered connection for 90 seconds instead of giving up sooner
A sub-agent stopped at its turn limit reports its unfinished work instead of an empty result
A token-endpoint outage fails the MCP tool call but keeps the server's sign-in
A turn cut off by the output-token cap or the step limit now says it stopped early
`/context show` lists a `skill://` file that could not be loaded instead of leaving it out
Sessions whose transcript grew past 512 MiB can be opened again
Shell commands run in `bash` when it is available and `SHELL` is unset, instead of `/bin/sh`
Starting a session no longer deletes the logs of another session that is still running
`str_replace` writes `$$`, `$&` and other `$` patterns in the new text as written
Sub-agents load the `file://` resources their own agent profile declares
A prompt sent just as a workflow run finishes is no longer dropped
Spec task runs record property-based test results without asking for approval
Workflow runs land their changes on your checked-out branch, not a leftover worktree branch
`kiro-cli agent upgrade` and `/upgrade-agent` now warn when an agent lists V2 tools that V3 doesn't have, such as `todo_list`
Tool cards in scrollback no longer show a `ctrl+o to toggle` hint after they stop responding to it
An empty model reply after a tool call ends the turn instead of retrying up to 300 times
MCP and web tools stay on for organization users when a later profile check fails
MCP sign-in links disappear once their server connects, with the server named in the toast
"Run required tasks" on a spec finishes every required task instead of stopping partway
Shell commands that read input get end of input at once instead of waiting until they time out
Mermaid sequence diagrams render multiline labels, branches, async arrows and `rect` regions correctly
`kiro-cli agent validate` now exits non-zero when the agent config is invalid or missing
A damaged knowledge listing no longer prevents a session or sub-agent from starting
Agent requests reach the correct service hosts in isolated AWS regions
`PreToolUse` hooks that exit 2 block the tool even when they give no reason
Stopping a Windows shell command also stops the child processes it started
Sub-agent knowledge bases refresh when agent files change instead of serving stale text
Resizing the terminal no longer blanks the chat or paints rows at the old width
Scrolled-back chat keeps the line you were reading when the terminal width changes
The footer's session credit total no longer resets to zero when a session is reopened
`--no-interactive` runs and `kiro-cli acp` no longer print the agent's `[INFO]` startup lines on stderr
`--no-interactive` output starts the text that follows a tool call on a new line
Cloud sessions in an unsupported region show as unavailable instead of failing every turn
Reopening a session after a crash during a save no longer drops the next entry written to its history
Pages over the 10 MB `web_fetch` limit are reported as too large instead of as a network error
Zero-result `web_search` calls show the search provider's message instead of an empty result
Tool output stays on the same screen row when expanded or collapsed in fullscreen chat
Tool-use telemetry is exported when an organization turns on only an OpenTelemetry export, not just the user activity report; `telemetry.enabled` and `KIRO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` still stop it
Remote MCP server registrations and credential folders are now owner-only on Unix
[V2] `git` commands prefixed with `GIT_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE` now ask for approval
Kiro CLI V3 is now the default experience, with workflows, specs, cloud sessions and more
The Classic experience is retired; new capabilities are built in the terminal UI
Inline shell autocomplete and the CLI desktop app are retired
